Subject: Q3 recruiting matrix + req approvals

Team — attaching the recruiting matrix for Q3 (v2). I ran it against the current headcount budget and the latest revenue forecast; the high-level asks:

- We have 9 open reqs that hiring managers say are critical; 4 are backfills, 5 are new headcount.
- Two items need executive/finance sign-off before I can post: REQ-1123 (SRE backfill) and REQ-1140 (ML infra, new).
- There are a few non-customer-facing IC roles that could be deferred to Q4 if we need to hit a budget freeze.

Please review the sheet and mark APPROVE / HOLD inline. I highlighted what the recruiting partners are ready to open this week. Also attached the org chart snapshot. We need a short formal decision by EOD Wednesday so I can finalize recruiting runways for QBR slides.

Attachments: Q3_Recruiting_Matrix_v2.xlsx, org_chart_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Laura

Thanks Laura. Quick clarifying Qs before I mark anything:

- For REQ-1123 (SRE backfill) — is this a straight backfill for an active oncall seat? If so I think we should prioritize.
- For REQ-1140 (ML infra) — what's the runway to benefit? Is this hiring now vs Q4 materially changing our Q3 billing/throughput work?

If folks are comfortable with the SRE backfill I can sign off quickly; the ML infra role I'd like a 1-paragraph business case from the hiring manager to include in the QBR notes.

-Aditya
Senior Director, Product Engineering

+1 on prioritizing customer-facing/backfill roles. From a product cadence perspective: we can push non-customer-facing research ICs to Q4 without shipping risk. REQ-1123 is replacing an engineer who left in April and we are currently running down 2x oncall rotations — this is time-sensitive.

I'll put a short business-case note for REQ-1140 into the Drive folder (link in the sheet) — it primarily unlocks end-to-end model retraining throughput that would reduce inference latency for long tails. My ask is: if the finance team wants to conserve budget, freeze brand-new research hires but approve operational backfills.

Hannah
Director, Product
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Thanks — good discussion. High-level guidance from me so the team can finalize slides for the QBR: 

- Approve immediate backfills for customer-facing and reliability roles. That includes REQ-1123 (SRE backfill) — approved.
- For new headcount (research/expansion roles): place a soft freeze except for ML infra (REQ-1140). I want a one-paragraph justification for REQ-1140 in the QBR appendix (Hannah to add).
- Freeze lower-priority IC roles and any contractor-to-FTE conversions unless a manager makes a compelling business case.

Laura — please capture the approved/frozen decisions in the updated matrix and highlight items that require Finance sign-off for reimbursement cadence. We need a slide that shows hiring runway (time-to-fill) and budget impact by week for the next 12 weeks.

I'll sign off on the approvals once the matrix reflects the changes and Finance/HR confirm headcount availability. If anyone needs an exception, escalate to me with the business impact.

Jonas
VP, Engineering Operations
